dimensionRule: Dimensions are categorical evidence views, not ordinal scores; they MUST NOT be averaged, summed or converted into a global percentage.
laws: REGION_MEMBER_COVERAGE DOES NOT TRANSFER TO REGION

mappingRelations.ADJACENT_NOT_COVERAGE: Owner boundary or imported concepts are adjacent to the identity; this is explicitly not counted as coverage.
mappingRelations.BRIDGE_COVERAGE: Owner directly investigates a cross-boundary structure touching the identity but does not own/investigate the external field as a whole.
mappingRelations.DIRECT_PARTIAL_COVERAGE: Owner-current semantics directly investigate a bounded subspace of the ReferenceIdentity. Never means whole external field coverage.
mappingRelations.OUT_OF_FOUNDATIONAL_PILOT_SCOPE: Owner research is real/current but the bounded foundational reference pilot has no relevant admitted identity/region; do not classify as untouched.
mappingRelations.REFERENCE_MODEL_GAP_CANDIDATE: Owner-current semantics are mature but no current normalized external identity is a good direct coordinate; suggests a Reference Model gap requiring external-source verification.

regionRule: MajorRegion projections may list mapped member identities and unmapped anchors for navigation only. They cannot inherit or aggregate member coverage into a region-level coverage truth.
